title: Chacha mai aapki turbat
body:
Chacha mai aapki turbat
Haye chacha abbas..(3)
Haan..
arey jab dafn karne aaye, tane paash paash ko
abid pukare dekh ke ghazi ki laash ko
<<MINI>>
chacha mai aapki turbat banane aaya hu
sakina ab bhi hai pyaasi batane aaya hu
chacha mai aapki turbat banane aaya hu..(2)
sakina ab bhi hai pyaasi batane aaya hu
chacha mai aapki turbat banane aaya hu..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Batau kaise chacha kya guzar gayi hum par
har ek shehr mein maare gaye hame patthar
thi maaein phupiya mere saath aye ali ke pisar
ye saari zulm ke qisse sunane aaya hu
<<MINI>>
chacha mai aapki turbat banane aaya hu..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Haram ko chodke kufe se aa raha hu chacha
bata gay hai tumhari wasiyatein baba
wahi ho qabr chida tha jaha'n pe mashkiza
kiya tha sheh se jo waada nibhane aaya hu
<<MINI>>
chacha mai aapki turbat banane aaya hu..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hai teen roz se laashe pe dhoop ka saaya
ye haal dekhke rota hai khoon dil mera
ghareeb hu mai kafan tumko de nahi sakta
haye tumhari laash ke tukde uthane aaya hu
<<MINI>>
chacha mai aapki turbat banane aaya hu..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sakina raah mein naake se gir gayi thi abhi
wahi hai taaza riwayat kamar pe likkhi hui
hai jaari khoon jo is waqt aydiyo'n se meri
laee'n se khake abhi taaziyane aaya hu
<<MINI>>
chacha mai aapki turbat banane aaya hu..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tumhare saamne aati hai sharm kehte hue
ye baat karta bhala kaise saamne unke
abhi hai door yaha se bani asad wale
haye, phuphi ki chinn gayi chadar batane aaya hu
<<MINI>>
chacha mai aapki turbat banane aaya hu..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. La'ee ne bachhi ke gauhar ko aise cheena tha
giri zamee'n pe sakina mai khoon rota tha
wo jis zameen pe kaanto'n se khoon tapka tha
wo khaak rakhne tumhare sirhane aaya hu
<<MINI>>
chacha mai aapki turbat banane aaya hu..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Baghair inke tum utre the zeen se kaise
haram to lut gaye ye baazu kat gaye jab se
pade the door ye laashe se aapke kabse
kate ye baazu badan se milane aaya hu
<<MINI>>
chacha mai aapki turbat banane aaya hu..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Banake qabr takallum wo bola ro ro kar
yaha'n pe aayenge ab zaereen shaam o sahar
jale khayam ki rakh kar lahad pe khaak magar
haye, mai pehla farsh azaa ka bichane aaya hu
<<MINI>>
chacha mai aapki turbat banane aaya hu..(2)
